descriptions.value: In secure_transport_usecase_handshake of secure_transport.c, there is a possible way to bypass secure transport channel encryption due to a logic error. This could lead to local escalation of privilege with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.
Missing authorization in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.
